scoring_justification: T1/T2 infeasible: absolute K values are strongly method-dependent (code, pseudopotentials). Only the relative trends (ordering, monotonicity, strain response) are robust, as stated in the paper's conclusions. Scoring structural relationships.

steps.description: Check that K(x) exhibits a maximum near x=0.3 and a minimum near x=0.8: K(0.3) > K(0.0), K(0.8) < K(0.3), and K(0.8) is lower than both K(0.5) and K(1.0).
Check that K increases with c/a ratio: values for c/a = 0.81005, 0.8351, 0.860153 are non-decreasing, and K at +3% strain is at least 1.5 times K at zero strain.
